versions.name: Bear Creek Scout Camp

features.note: Taught through the metalworking merit badge.
The Ranger Program, for members new to Scouts BSA.
Pottery, photography, leatherworking, and wood carving.
The Bear Claw, a five-day challenge-by-choice track.
The Bear Claw track is for youth thirteen and older who have finished eighth grade.

versions.summary: Alamo Area Council's Scouts BSA resident summer camp near Hunt, Texas, offering Bear Claw, Ranger first-year, and traditional program tracks.

provenance.notes: Imported from camp-finder; raw description and sessions dropped (operational data stays at the council site). verified_at is camp-finder's own source-confirmation date; imported_at is when open-scout-api ingested it. The evergreen summary is original prose regenerated from that description, excluding dates/fees/schedules. camp_type classified from program_types. Features surveyed 2026-07-25 against the council's own camp page (that page is explicitly not an exhaustive activity list, so absence of a code is not evidence of absence). The stored page is the council's multi-camp Camps index; only its Bear Creek section was used, and the dedicated page is https://www.alamoareascouting.org/summer-camp/rangercamp/.
